title: Safety and Efficacy of Oxymetazoline HCl Cream 1.0% in Patients With Persistent Erythema Associated With Rosacea
brief_summary: This study will evaluate the safety and efficacy of oxymetazoline hydrochloride (HCl) cream 1.0% (AGN-199201) once daily compared to vehicle for the treatment of persistent moderate to severe facial erythema associated with rosacea.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

-Moderate to severe persistent facial erythema associated with rosacea.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Greater than 3 inflammatory lesions on the face
* Current treatment with monoamine oxidase (MAO) inhibitors
* Raynaud's syndrome, narrow angle glaucoma, orthostatic hypotension, scleroderma or Sjogren's syndrome.
